remarks: Welcome to Ridge View at Quarry, where luxury meets customization. Situated on a premium lot backing directly onto a Water Pond, this stunning 2,509 sq. ft. home is designed with upgraded luxury finishes and a thoughtfully planned layout. The main floor features an impressive open-to-above design, a full bedroom and bathroom, spice kitchen and spacious living areas. Want something different? The floor plan, finishes and design can be customized to suit your lifestyle and vision. Multiple premium lots are available throughout the community, including options backing onto the golf course, pond and lake, with the ability to accommodate a variety of home sizes and layouts.
